opening.argument: The video promotes a BitConnect-linked cryptocurrency opportunity through a referral URL and presents participation as a “Revolutionary Change,” while its title foregrounds a “$100000 Give Away....Thanks Tre.” The speaker also identifies “here is my referral” and urges viewers to “go into it and be part of it.” Together, these are not neutral cryptocurrency education: they frame the opportunity as revolutionary, attach participation to referral activity, and use a large giveaway claim to attract involvement. The displayed earning message further indicates that users can earn by referring new members, making recruitment central to the opportunity. These features support a recruitment-based, tiered promotional model, while the available evidence does not establish particular losses or a guaranteed outcome.
